items.title: pinky
items.description: Let AI agents use your phone, with you in the loop.
items.summary: Pinky lets any AI agent use your iPhone or Android phone, from macOS, Windows or Linux, with you in the loop. It enables agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or a script to operate a real phone over MCP, while you watch on your computer, approve risky steps, take over, and review what happened. To use Pinky, plug the phone into the computer, unlock it, tap Trust, and enter the passcode. On Windows, install Apple Devices from the Microsoft Store first; on Linux, install the `usbmuxd` package. On the iPhone, turn on Developer Mode in Settings › Privacy & Security.

items.title: vork
items.description: Headless 3D and VFX engine for agents. Research preview.
items.summary: Vork is a headless 3D and visual-effects engine designed for agents, allowing them to write scenes as code, render them, inspect the results, and revise the code. It is written in Rust and Slang, with GPU rendering through Vulkan and Metal. The engine is currently in research preview and is source-available and free. The repository reports 802 stars and a velocity of 430 stars per day, indicating early interest. Demos include a million-bird flocking simulation, a Schwarzschild black hole, and VFX composited onto real footage. Final renders run 1.4-2.3x faster than Blender EEVEE on timing, though at lower sample counts with visible quality trade-offs. The project is marked as a research preview, and the source does not provide information on its practical application for ready-made production tools.

items.title: poki
items.description: Let AI agents operate a real iPhone. Local MCP server and agent, no jailbreak, no extra hardware.
items.summary: Poki is an open-source project that allows AI agents to operate a real iPhone by running as a local MCP server. It connects to AI agents like Claude Code or Codex to perform actions such as tapping, swiping, and typing on an actual iPhone without requiring a jailbreak or extra hardware. It needs a Mac running macOS 15+ with full Xcode, Node.js 24+, and ffmpeg. Poki passed 449 stars and 94 forks on GitHub within two days and is under 450 stars as of the latest update. The project aims to let AI agents step out of the chat window and into the apps we use daily.

items.title: hermes-voice
items.description: Talk to a Hermes Agent profile through Home Assistant Assist
items.summary: Hermes Agent integrates with Mattermost as a bot, allowing you to chat with your AI assistant through direct messages or team channels. To use it, open a direct message with the bot in Mattermost. Hermes Agent uses your Mattermost User ID to control who can interact with the bot. The bot connects via Mattermost's REST API (v4) and WebSocket for real-time events, processes messages through the Hermes Agent pipeline, and responds in real time. Hermes Agent is free and open source under the MIT license, and it can be downloaded for macOS or Windows or installed via terminal. It supports text, file sharing, and can be connected to various messaging platforms.

items.title: phoneuse
items.description: See and operate an unmodified iPhone from a Linux PC: AirPlay mirror in, Bluetooth HID mouse/keyboard out, plus a CLI and skill for agents.
items.summary: Phone Use mirrors a real iPhone to Linux over AirPlay, then drives it with Bluetooth mouse and keyboard. It includes an unmodified iPhone, no jailbreak or app required, recipes for every interaction, an agent skill and MCP server, and a CLI for tap, type, swipe, open, and back. The agent reads text instead of screenshots due to out-of-band OCR. It is MIT licensed and works with Claude Code. The sources do not provide specific dates or URLs beyond what is mentioned.

items.title: solo-to-team-skills
items.description: Skills for human-led AI teams: delegate tasks, verify evidence, explain steps clearly, and learn from real cases. 一个人统筹 AI 团队：派活、核证、清楚说明、经验复用。
items.summary: Skills for human-led AI teams include delegating tasks, verifying evidence, explaining steps clearly, and learning from real cases. The sources emphasize the importance of understanding AI’s capabilities and limits, deciding when AI leads versus humans, and translating AI logic to non-technical teams. Leadership roles are shifting, with routine supervision and micromanagement becoming less relevant as AI handles more tasks. Leaders must focus on setting direction, exercising judgment, and holding accountability, while AI executes workflows. Human oversight remains essential for tasks involving nuance and discretion, such as identifying the real problem and interpreting results.

items.description: Trx Drainer Bot 2023 pre-configured environment for automated AI-driven transaction processing in enterprise software catalog.
items.summary: The sources indicate that "trx-drainer-bot" is a pre-configured environment for automated AI-driven transaction processing in enterprise software, with a GitHub repository maintained by MorningStage that has 218 stars as of the latest update on November 6, 2026. The bot is described as an automated deployment pipeline for efficient AI-driven data extraction and processing in an enterprise-grade software catalog. Additionally, the YouTube video demonstrates the bot's functionality in AI automated trading for TRX, showing its live dashboard and trading capabilities on iOS and Android devices. The Vestinda article discusses the integration of AI indicators in TRX trading bots, emphasizing the importance of automation in cryptocurrency trading.

items.title: devvm
items.description: One VM for every project. An isolated sandbox with your project’s toolchain, ready for you or a coding agent to start coding
items.summary: devvm provides an isolated sandbox for every project, automatically detecting the required toolchains from the project's files. It supports coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and opencode, which run within the VM without installation on the user's machine. Each project gets its own VM, which mounts only the project folder, ensuring isolation and security. devvm's network tiers limit the VM's reach to only allowed hosts, and secrets remain on the user's machine. The tool is free and open source under the MIT license, offering sensible defaults to start coding in a sandbox with minimal configuration.

items.title: youtube-ai-video-editing-system
items.description: Eyeline teleprompter meets editing agents: JSON-driven animation and motion graphics workflow
items.summary: The sources indicate that the YouTube-AI-Video-Editing-System project on GitHub includes an Eyeline teleprompter, editing agents, and a JSON-driven animation and motion graphics workflow. The system allows users to connect scripts, recorded takes, source clips, and designed visuals, keeping its decisions in readable Markdown and JSON. The workflow also features an animated board library with play/pause/scrubbing, JSON timelines, and a local frame renderer for narration-aligned graphics. Additionally, the sources mention Opus Clip for auto segmenting, AI B-roll insertion, and XML export for NLEs, and DomoAI for frames to video, 50+ styles, and 4K output up to 30 seconds.

items.title: ai-app-builder-open
items.description: Open-source AI app builder for full-stack Next.js apps with hosting and auth
items.summary: The ai-app-builder-open is an open-source AI app builder for full-stack Next.js apps that includes hosting, sandbox, database, and authentication. It supports various authentication providers like Supabase Auth, Better Auth, Clerk, and Auth0, and payment providers like Stripe. The builder runs on Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS 4. It offers a live preview, code editor, managed database, secrets management, one-click hosting, custom domains, and bidirectional GitHub sync. The apps built with this tool come with managed database, hosting, authentication, and custom domains as part of the build.

items.title: aida-64-extreme-desktop

It offers detailed information on hardware configuration, installed programs, software licenses, security applications, and Windows settings. It includes diagnostics, benchmarks, and real-time monitoring of voltage, temperature, and fan speed. The latest version available is 8.40, released on September 15, 2026. The software is available for download on Uptodown and its official website provides further features and purchasing options.

items.title: ozone-mastering-suite

items.summary: The Ozone-mastering-suite AI-Assisted Mastering Suite with Spectral Shaping and Codec Preview is part of the Ozone 12 Advanced edition. The Spectral Shaper module is used for dynamic spectral shaping technology to add instant polish and control harsh frequencies. The Codec Preview tool allows users to hear their mix as an MP3/AAC at 8 resolutions to test any loss of audio quality before release day. The jump from Standard to Advanced adds 6 more modules including Spectral Shaper and the Codec Preview tool, which are useful but not essential for most self-mastering work.

It uses a Flux Grid Resonance Circuit example from a plain-language brief and a 2D starter template, and includes features like a live Canvas 2D preview, CSP-enforced network isolation, and a single-file offline HTML export. DeepSeek Harness (dsh) is an open-source agent harness for building coding and workflow agents, with plugins for various functionalities like theme customization, text streaming, and 3D model previews. The sources do not provide a definitive answer on describing a small game, playing it in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, swapping in AI art, and publishing to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare in one click.

items.title: airpointer
items.summary: The airpointer is an ambient air quality monitoring station that offers analysis modules for monitoring airborne pollutants such as SO2, NO2/NOX, CO, O3, and PM, relevant to the EU, WHO, US-EPA, and other organizations. It supports modular configurations for classic air pollutants and particulate matter, including PM10, PM2.5, and TSP. The airpointer can be used for ambient air, industrial, traffic, indoor, mobile, and permanent monitoring applications. It can be mounted on poles, walls, trailers, or transporters and is designed for connected monitoring, allowing authorized users to access data via an internet connection using a web browser. The airpointer features a compact design, silent operation, and a rugged, inconspicuous burglar-proof construction.

items.title: wrapvm

items.title: claude-jailbreak-prompt
items.description: Optimized local environment suite for Claude AI pipeline management and custom automation workflows.
items.summary: The sources discuss techniques for bypassing Anthropic's safety training or restrictions on the Claude AI model, known as "jailbreaking." They describe various categories of jailbreaking methods, including roleplay and persona injection, many-shot jailbreaking, token encoding obfuscation, and multi-turn escalation. The sources also highlight that the most dangerous attacks are not single-prompt jailbreaks but multi-turn adversarial sequences. They emphasize that the real risk lies in prompt injection and application-layer attacks on custom deployments of Claude, which operate outside Anthropic's safety training controls. The sources do not provide specific details on an "optimized local environment suite for Claude AI pipeline management and custom automation workflows."

items.title: ste80-humanizer
items.description: STE80 Humanizer: agent skill that removes AI tells and rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), the method Andrej Karpathy shared.
items.summary: The STE80 Humanizer is a tool designed to remove AI tics from text, aiming to produce clearer and more concise writing rather than text that mimics human voice. It rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100, a simplified technical English inspired by Andrej Karpathy's method. The tool is not intended to fool someone into thinking a human wrote it but to enhance clarity and conciseness. The GitHub repository for ASD-STE100 mentions the use of Karpathy's "80% ASD-STE100" tip, and a blog post elaborates on how this approach leverages technical writing standards to make LLM outputs more readable.

The server provides read-only tools over the ontology, and users sign in through Auto-Ontology with their permissions. The server is configured in the client's configuration file, and the setup requires restarting the client after editing its config. The sources do not provide specific details about the server's URL, port, or authentication credentials beyond the general setup instructions.

It supports both boundary-aware and post-turn queuing methods, allowing users to choose the appropriate queuing method for their workflows. Tinker's advantage lies in its ability to dramatically speed up training and deployment times, providing researchers with control over the training loop without needing to manage distributed infrastructure. The sources also mention a specific example of a Claude Code skill that fine-tunes a small model using production traces from an agent's interactions.

items.title: agentcase-lab
items.description: AI Agent failure replay and root cause analysis platform
items.summary: The Agentic Root Cause Analysis Agent (Failure Investigator) autonomously investigates equipment failures using fault tree analysis, causal inference, and pattern recognition across multiple data types to deliver consistent, evidence-backed root cause findings and corrective action recommendations. It analyzes failure events across equipment fleets, correlates data from various sources, and delivers transparent investigation reports with traceable evidence paths. The tool reduces diagnosis time from hours to minutes by automatically identifying failures in agent execution traces and performing root cause analysis. AgentOps, another tool mentioned, is a developer-focused observability platform designed for autonomous AI agents, supporting over 400 LLMs and frameworks with time-travel debugging and session replay capabilities.

items.title: good-door

items.summary: good-door is a simple, secure CLI tool designed to manage secrets for humans and agents. It allows secrets to be printed to the terminal and masked for agent shells. The tool is MIT-licensed and has 191 stars on GitHub. The sources do not provide information on its dynamic secret management capabilities or pricing.

items.title: chatgpt2api-dsh
items.summary: The sources describe "chatgpt2api-dsh" as an open-source project that compresses LLM API requests to reduce costs and trims wasted tokens from prompts and outputs. It is designed to work with any provider without additional model calls and includes an MCP server and embeddable library for multiple programming languages. The project aims to convert the capabilities of the official web interface of "ChatGPT" into a standardized HTTP API interface, facilitating integration with various AI models and tools compatible with the OpenAI API format.

items.title: best-agent-memory-mcp
items.description: Best Agent Memory MCP servers, ranked and compared: long-term memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any MCP client. Glen, Mem0, Supermemory, Zep, Hindsight, Basic Memory, claude-mem, Graphiti, Cognee, the official memory server and more, with storage, capture model, team sharing, license and live stars.
items.summary: The sources provide information on three memory platforms: Cognee, Basic Memory, and Supermemory. Cognee is an open-source agent memory platform based in Berlin, Germany, that allows LLM agents to capture context and recall it across sessions. Basic Memory, based in Austin, Texas, is an open-source AI memory and knowledge base that serves as a one-stop place for notes, decisions, and workflows for teams and AI tools. Supermemory, headquartered in San Francisco, California, is a context engineering platform that powers enterprise APIs, developer plugins, and a personal app that remembers everything. The sources do not provide a definitive ranking or comparison of these platforms.

items.title: image-to-sculpt
items.description: Turn one image of anything into a 3D sculpt measured against that image: registered views, map-fitting passes, Blender replay and timelapse. A skill for coding agents.
items.summary: The GitHub repository gokayfem/image-to-sculpt details a process for turning an image into a 3D sculpt, including registered views, map-fitting passes, Blender replay, and a timelapse. The process involves fitting, checking, Blender steps, and delivering a timelapse ending in a 360° turn. The magnific.com blog mentions that Blender is where most meshes land for retopo, UVs, rigging, and rendering, and it can turn depth maps into displaced geometry for quick bas-reliefs from a single photo. The mcpmarket.com tool outlines a pipeline for image to 3D modeling, including multi-view reconstruction, Blender cleanup, high-resolution texture baking, and exporting to GLB.

items.title: ovnfs
items.description: Checkouts for agents: isolated, copy-on-write copies of any folder
items.summary: The sources describe "ovnfs" as a repository on GitHub that provides "checkouts for agents: isolated, copy-on-write copies of any folder." This indicates that ovnfs is designed to create isolated environments for agents, where changes are made in a copy-on-write (CoW) manner, allowing for safe experimentation and review before any permanent changes are committed to the main database. This approach facilitates database-level isolation for agentic workflows, enabling users to review and approve agent outputs before they affect production data.

items.title: download-anything
items.description: 面向 AI Agent 与终端的全能下载与归档工具 / All-in-one CLI & Skill to download anything: videos, docs, cloud drives, music, papers & books
items.summary: CLI-Anything is a framework designed to transform traditional software applications into agent-native command-line interfaces that can be directly controlled by AI systems. It is built on the idea that the command-line interface is the most universal, structured, and composable interface for both humans and AI agents, enabling deterministic and predictable execution of workflows. The system provides a methodology and tooling for generating CLI wrappers around existing applications, allowing them to be controlled programmatically using natural language instructions interpreted by AI agents. It integrates with multiple AI platforms such as Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI, enabling cross-platform compatibility and flexibility. CLI-Anything emphasizes structured outputs such as JSON to reduce parsing complexity and improve reliability in automation scenarios.

It allows users to type a scene, choose the shape (wide, vertical, or square), and get an MP4 file. It operates without credits, subscription, or queue, and is compatible with Windows 10/11. The app is open-source, MIT licensed, and has garnered over 200 stars shortly after its launch. items.title: gpt-anime-denoise
items.description: Remove the fish-scale noise GPT image models leave in anime / TV-anime images (ESRGAN @60% + L0 smoothing)
items.summary: The gpt-anime-denoise project aims to remove the fish-scale noise that GPT image models leave in anime and TV-anime style images using ESRGAN at 60% reduction followed by L0 smoothing. The recommended method is ESRGAN at 60% + L0 0.001, which is effective for anime and TV-anime styles. The tool allows users to drag and drop images for denoising, offers three strength levels, and provides a local brush for protecting specific areas. The project has seen an increase in stars and forks recently, indicating growing interest.

items.title: WebsiteBench
items.description: Can AI agents rebuild websites through browser exploration?
items.summary: According to the sources, AI agents can rebuild websites through browser exploration, as demonstrated by WebsiteBench. The project shows that giving the agent a human exploration trace, a log of browser actions without page content, raised the mean score on 18 paired websites from 2.8% to 9.8%. The agent can navigate, click, type, and take screenshots but cannot read HTML, scripts, or server code. The agent has up to 16 hours to write a full-stack site that looks and behaves the same as the reference website. The sources do not provide a definitive answer on the specific limitations or challenges faced by the agents in this process.

items.title: sakutto
items.description: A browser extension for easy on-device translation with a local LLM (PLaMo). Private, free, no server needed.
items.summary: PLaMo Translate is a browser extension for Chrome and Firefox that offers on-device translation using a local LLM, free of charge and without requiring a server. It is available for Windows and Mac, and it can translate entire web pages while maintaining their layout. The extension can be added to Chrome and Edge, and it uses a discrete GPU through Vulkan when available, or the fastest CPU code path supported by the CPU. The extension is part of a larger application that includes a desktop app and supports various translation features. The extension is registered with Chrome and Edge through the app's settings, and it uses the `plamo-translate-host` for native messaging. The extension is available for free, with options to upgrade to Lite or Pro plans based on usage and features.

items.title: headless
items.description: Agent skill that sets up a headless Mac, Linux or Windows machine over SSH, step by step, without ever seeing the admin password.
items.summary: To set up a headless Mac mini for AI agents without ever seeing the admin password, disable FileVault, enable auto-login, and configure sleep settings to keep the machine awake and reachable. Install a remote desktop app like Workbench for oversight from mobile devices. For SSH access, disable password authentication in `/etc/ssh/sshd_config` by setting `PasswordAuthentication no` and `PubkeyAuthentication yes`, then generate an SSH key with `ssh-keygen -t ed25519`, copy the public key to the Mac Mini’s `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`, and confirm key-based login works. For remote access, use Tailscale to set up a secure VPN with the command `curl -fsSL <https://tailscale.com/sdk> | sh` and then `sudo tailscale up`.

items.title: AimMac
items.description: Point your iPhone at your Mac and the cursor follows. Tap to click, hold to drag. Bluetooth only, open source.
items.summary: AimMac allows you to use your iPhone to control your Mac's cursor via Bluetooth. The iPhone app sends signals directly to the Mac, which requires macOS 14 or later. The iPhone app and Mac app need to be built from the code available under the MIT license on GitHub. You can tap to click, hold to drag, and use the iPhone's accelerometer and gyroscope to aim the cursor. The iPhone can also function as a trackpad by placing it flat and swiping with a finger. The setup does not require Wi-Fi or servers, and the experience feels similar to using a trackpad with haptic feedback.

items.title: mindact-agent
items.description: MindAct: Community-Driven AI Agent for Claude, Obsidian, and RAG Knowledge Graphs
items.summary: MindAct is a community-driven AI agent designed to integrate seamlessly with Obsidian, a local-first, Markdown-based note-taking app. It reads, links, and enriches notes directly within Obsidian, creating a personal knowledge graph that can be queried through natural-language commands. MindAct leverages the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and plugins like Smart Connections to provide a high-fidelity Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline, grounding responses in the user's own notes rather than generic information. The agent is shaped by community feedback, with feature requests and bug reports directly influencing its development.

items.title: fabric-mlv-agent-healthcare-starter
items.description: Fabric MLV healthcare demo template: lake views, ontology, data agents
items.summary: The fabric-mlv-agent-healthcare-starter Fabric MLV healthcare demo template includes an ontology, semantic models, data agents, and graphs all situated in a single lake. The ontology is designed to represent the healthcare domain, connecting operational data with real-time vital signs monitoring. The Fabric data agent supports up to five data sources, including lakehouses, warehouses, KQL databases, Power BI semantic models, ontologies, and Microsoft Graph, and uses large language models to help users interact with their data naturally.
